blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (States and Phases of Matter) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the general properties of gases in the light of kinetic molecular theory. (4 marks)
(Kinetic molecular theory ki roshni mein gases ki aam khusoosiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Shakal aur hajm: Gases ki koi muqarrara shakal aur hajm nahi. Gas ka hajm bartan ka hajm hota hai.
2. Khaali jagah aur compressibility: Gas ke molecules door door hain; gas ke hajm ka taqreeban 99.9% khaali jagah hai. Is liye gas aasani se compress hoti hai.
3. Joule-Thomson effect: Gas ke achanak phailne (sudden expansion) par thandak paida hoti hai.
4. Pressure: Gas ka pressure molecules ke bartan ki deewaron se takraane se hota hai.
5. Ideal gases: In ke particles ka hajm sifar aur intermolecular forces na hone ke barabar hain.

book_ref.quote: Kinetic molecular theory of gases can help us to understand their properties.

blocks.prompt:
2 Derive the ideal gas equation PV = nRT by combining Boyle's, Charles' and Avogadro's laws. Give the value of R. (4 marks)
(Boyle's, Charles' aur Avogadro's laws ko mila kar ideal gas equation PV = nRT derive karein. R ki qeemat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gas laws batate hain ke gas ki di gayi miqdaar ka hajm temperature aur pressure par kaise munhasir hai.
Boyle's law: V ∝ 1/P (n aur T qaayam) ... (1)
Charles' law: V ∝ T (n aur P qaayam) ... (2)
Avogadro's law: V ∝ n (P aur T qaayam) ... (3)

Agar koi variable qaayam na rakhein to teeno ta'alluqaat jod dein:
V ∝ nT/P
V = constant × nT/P
Constant R hai (ideal gas constant), R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. Is liye
V = R nT/P
PV = nRT ... (4)
Equation (4) ideal gas equation hai.

book_ref.quote: If we think for a moment that none of the variables are to be kept constant, then all the above three relationships can be joined together as:

blocks.prompt:
3 Show how the ideal gas equation is used to find the relative molecular mass of a gas. Which quantities must be measured? (4 marks)
(Dikhayein ke ideal gas equation se gas ka relative molecular mass kaise nikaalte hain. Kaun si miqdaarein naapni zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Gas ka relative molecular mass tab nikalta hai jab us ka pressure P, temperature T, hajm V aur mass m (grams mein) maloom hon.

Ideal gas equation: PV = nRT ... (4)
Moles n = m/M, jahan m = mass grams mein aur M = molar mass. (4) mein rakhne se:
PV = mRT/M ... (5)
(5) ko tarteeb dene se:
M = mRT/PV ... (6)
Molecular satah par molar mass relative molecular mass ban jata hai:
Mᵣ = mRT/PV ... (7)

R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ ke saath P atm mein, V dm³ mein aur T kelvin mein (T = °C + 273).

book_ref.quote: Equation (4) can be employed to calculate the relative molecular mass of a gas whose P, T, V and mass in grams are known.

blocks.prompt:
4 2.2 g of a gas occupies 1.0 dm³ at 127 °C under a pressure of 1.5 atm. Calculate the relative molecular mass of the gas. (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(2.2 g gas 127 °C aur 1.5 atm pressure par 1.0 dm³ gherti hai. Gas ka relative molecular mass nikalein. (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Temperature ko kelvin mein badlein aur Mᵣ = mRT/PV lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Solution: The molecular mass of the gas can be calculated by using the formula: M = mRT/PV

steps: Data: m = 2.2 g, P = 1.5 atm, V = 1.0 dm³, R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: Gas ka relative molecular mass = 48.2 (molar mass 48.2 g mol⁻¹)

blocks.prompt:
5 A 6.0 dm³ cylinder contains a gas at 27 °C and 3.0 atm. (i) How many moles of gas are present? (ii) If the mass of the gas is 23.4 g, find its molar mass. (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(6.0 dm³ ke cylinder mein gas 27 °C aur 3.0 atm par hai. (i) Gas ke kitne moles hain? (ii) Agar gas ka mass 23.4 g ho to us ka molar mass nikalein. (R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: PV = nRT se n nikalein, phir M = m/n.

book_ref.quote: The equation (4) is called the ideal gas equation.

blocks.prompt:
6 Calculate the mass of carbon dioxide gas present in a 4.1 dm³ vessel at 27 °C and 2.0 atm. (Molar mass of CO₂ = 44 g mol⁻¹; R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(27 °C aur 2.0 atm par 4.1 dm³ ke bartan mein carbon dioxide gas ka mass nikalein. (CO₂ ka molar mass = 44 g mol⁻¹; R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: PV = mRT/M ko m ke liye tarteeb dein.

book_ref.quote: Putting n = m/M in equation (4) Where m = mass in g and M = molar mass of the gas

steps: PV = mRT/M, is liye m = PVM/RT

blocks.prompt:
7 16 g of oxygen gas is enclosed in a 10 dm³ vessel at 27 °C. Calculate the pressure of the gas. (Molar mass of O₂ = 32 g mol⁻¹; R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(16 g oxygen gas 27 °C par 10 dm³ ke bartan mein band hai. Gas ka pressure nikalein. (O₂ ka molar mass = 32 g mol⁻¹; R = 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Mass se moles nikalein, phir P = nRT/V.

book_ref.quote: The constant suggested is ‘R’ which is called Ideal gas constant.

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the properties of liquids: diffusion, intermolecular spaces, compressibility, motion of molecules, expansion and kinetic energy. (4 marks)
(Liquids ki khusoosiyaat bayan karein: diffusion, molecules ke darmiyan jagah, compressibility, molecules ki harkat, phailao aur kinetic energy.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Diffusion: Liquids gases ki tarah diffuse hote hain magar raftaar kahin kam hai.
2. Molecules ke darmiyan jagah: Nisbatan mazboot intermolecular forces ki wajah se thori jagah hai.
3. Compressibility: Liquids gases se 10⁵ guna kam magar solids se taqreeban 10 guna zyada compressible hain.
4. Harkat: Liquid molecules musalsal be-tarteeb harkat mein hain, gases se aahista. Miscible liquids ka diffusion is aazaad harkat ka saboot hai; isi se liquid behta hai.
5. Phailao: Garam karne par liquids phailte hain magar gases ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar.
6. Kinetic energy: Liquid molecules har temperature par kinetic energy rakhte hain jo temperature ke saath barhti ghat'ti hai. Thanda karne par (KE kam) liquid solid aur garam karne par (KE zyada) vapour banta hai.

book_ref.quote: According to kinetic molecular theory, molecules of a liquid are in constant motion

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain, with the help of the halogens, noble gases and alkanes, how molecular mass and chain length affect the strength of London dispersion forces and boiling points. (4 marks)
(Halogens, noble gases aur alkanes ki madad se wazahat karein ke molecular mass aur chain ki lambai London forces aur boiling points par kaise asar daalte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Molecular mass aur size: Mass jitna zyada, id-id forces utni mazboot, kyunke baray atom ya molecule ka electron cloud aasani se bikharta aur polarise hota hai.
• Halogens: F₂ (Mᵣ 38, b.p. 85 K) aur Cl₂ (71, 239 K) gas; Br₂ (159, 333 K) liquid; I₂ (253.8, 458 K) solid.
• Noble gases: b.p. He (4.003, 4.22 K) se Ne (27.1 K), Ar (87.3 K), Kr (120 K) hote hue Xe (131.3, 165 K) tak barhta hai.

Chain ki lambai (surface area): Lambe molecules ki lambai mein doosre molecules ko kheenchne ki zyada jaghein hain, is liye forces mazboot.
• C₂H₆ −88.6 °C aur C₆H₁₄ 68.7 °C par ubalta hai.
• Methane, ethane, propane, butane gas; pentane, hexane, decane liquid; icosane C₂₀H₄₂ solid.

book_ref.quote: When the molecular mass (Mᵣ) of a compound is greater, the id-id forces are stronger and vice versa.

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain how the shape (surface area) of molecules affects London dispersion forces, using the isomers of pentane. (4 marks)
(Pentane ke isomers ki misaal se wazahat karein ke molecules ki shakal (surface area) London forces par kaise asar daalti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Zyada surface area wala molecule qareebi molecules se zyada raabte rakhta hai, is liye forces mazboot hoti hain.

Pentane (C₅H₁₂) ke teen isomers ka Mᵣ aik jaisa magar structure aur surface area mukhtalif hai:
• n-pentane (seedhi chain): sab se zyada surface area, sab se mazboot forces, sab se zyada boiling point.
• 2-methylbutane (isopentane): n-pentane se kam surface area, darmiyani forces aur boiling point.
• 2,2-dimethylpropane (neopentane): sab se gol-mol, sab se kam surface area, sab se kamzor forces, sab se kam boiling point.

Boiling points ki tarteeb: neopentane < isopentane < n-pentane.

book_ref.quote: Three isomers of pentane have the same relative molecular mass (Mᵣ), however, they differ in their surface areas.

blocks.prompt:
11 What are permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces? Explain them in HCl and chloroform. (4 marks)
(Permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces kya hain? HCl aur chloroform mein in ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Aik polar molecule ke positive sire aur qareebi polar molecule ke negative sire ki kashish permanent dipole-permanent dipole force kehlati hai.

HCl: Cl zyada electronegative hai, is liye molecule polar hai, H^δ+–Cl^δ−. Liquid mein HCl molecules qareeb hon to line mein aa jaate hain, aik ka positive H sira agle ke negative Cl sire ki taraf:
H^δ+–Cl^δ− ··· H^δ+–Cl^δ− ··· H^δ+–Cl^δ−

Chloroform (CHCl₃): Yahi forces maujood hain. Molecule ka positive markaz H atom par aur negative markaz Cl atoms wale sire par hai; aik molecule ka H sira padosi ke Cl sire ko kheenchta hai.

book_ref.quote: Whenever the HCl molecules are close to each other (as in liquid state), they tend to line up as in Figure 5.3.

blocks.prompt:
12 What is a hydrogen bond? Give the conditions for its formation, its strength, and the factors on which the number of hydrogen bonds per molecule depends. (4 marks)
(Hydrogen bond kya hai? Is ke ban'ne ki sharaait, taaqat, aur woh awaamil likhein jin par har molecule ke hydrogen bonds ki tadaad munhasir hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Hydrogen bond: dipole-dipole force ki khaas qisam. Yeh sab se mazboot intermolecular force hai magar ionic, metallic aur covalent bonds se kamzor.

Sharaait:
1. Hydrogen atom kisi bohat electronegative atom jaise F, O ya N se jura ho.
2. Electronegative atom par lone pair ho.

Ban'na: Electronegative atom aur H ka bond bohat polarised hai; H par δ+ aur electronegative atom par δ−. Doosre molecule ke F, O ya N ka lone pair δ+ hydrogen ko bond banane deta hai. Yeh bond dotted line (…) se dikhaya jata hai aur is ki taaqat aam covalent bond ka das-wan hissa hai.

Hydrogen bonds ki tadaad munhasir hai:
1. electronegative atom se jure H atoms ki tadaad par;
2. F, O ya N par lone pairs ki tadaad par.
Misaal: H₂O (2 H, 2 lone pairs) ausatan do H-bonds; NH₃ (3 H, 1 lone pair) aur HF (1 H, 3 lone pairs) sirf aik.

book_ref.quote: The covalent bond between a highly electronegative atom and hydrogen is highly polarized.

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain the influence of hydrogen bonding on (i) the heat capacity, (ii) the enthalpy of vaporization and boiling point, and (iii) the surface tension and viscosity of water. (4 marks)
(Paani ki (i) heat capacity, (ii) enthalpy of vaporization aur boiling point, aur (iii) surface tension aur viscosity par hydrogen bonding ka asar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Zyada heat capacity: Paani ki specific heat capacity zyada hai kyunke is ki khaas saakht mazboot hydrogen bonds banne deti hai.

(ii) Ghair-mamooli enthalpy of vaporization aur boiling point: Group 16 hydrides mein H₂S se H₂Po tak enthalpy of vaporization baqaida barhti hai kyunke yeh London forces se jure hain jo atomic size ke saath mazboot hoti hain. Is trend se paani ki qeemat sab se kam honi chahiye thi. Magar paani ki sab se zyada (41 kJ mol⁻¹) hai aur boiling point bhi bohat zyada hai, kyunke is mein wasee hydrogen bonding hai aur molecules alag karne ke liye bohat energy chahiye.

(iii) Surface tension aur viscosity: Dono paani ke liye bohat zyada hain. Satah ke molecules ko andar ke molecules hydrogen bonds ke zariye andar kheenchte hain, jis se satah tani hui hoti hai. Viscosity (behne mein rukaawat) bhi isi wajah se zyada hai; hexane jaise hydrocarbons hydrogen bond nahi banate aur un ki viscosity kam hai.

book_ref.quote: The boiling point of water is also remarkably higher than the rest of group 16 hydrides.

blocks.prompt:
14 What is surface tension? Explain its cause, the factors affecting it, and the phenomena it influences. (4 marks)
(Surface tension kya hai? Is ki wajah, is par asar daalne wale awaamil, aur jin mazaahir par yeh asar daalti hai, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Surface tension liquids ki woh khusoosiyat hai jo liquid ki satah ke saath amal karne wali force bayan karti hai, jis se satah lachakdaar chaadar (elastic sheet) jaisi ho jati hai.

Wajah: Satah ke molecules par intermolecular forces ki wajah se khaalis andar ki taraf force hoti hai jo satah par 'jild' (skin) banati hai. Is liye liquids apna surface area kam karte hain aur qatre gol bante hain.

Awaamil:
1. Temperature: temperature barhne se surface tension aam taur par kam hoti hai.
2. Intermolecular forces: mazboot forces se surface tension zyada, maslan 20 °C par paani 72.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹ magar acetone 23.70 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹ (Table 5.3).

Mazaahir: capillary action, satahon ka geela hona, qatron aur bulbulon ka ban'na.
Units: N m⁻¹; 72.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹ = 72.75 dynes cm⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: This force arises due to the intermolecular forces between the molecules at the surface.

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain viscosity with the help of stirred water in a beaker. Give its units and the factors affecting it. (4 marks)
(Beaker mein hilaaye gaye paani ki madad se viscosity ki wazahat karein. Is ki units aur awaamil likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Wazahat: Beaker mein paani ko glass rod se hila kar chhor dein. Is ki gardishi harkat dheere dheere khatam hoti hai. Deewaron ke saath wali teh pehle aur markaz wali teh aakhir mein rukti hai. Deewar par ruki teh apne saath wali teh ko aahista karti hai; yeh agli andar wali teh ko kam had tak aahista karti hai. Yani aahista teh apne saath wali tez teh ko aahista karti hai: saath wali tehon ke darmiyan ragar (friction) ki force hai.

Definition: Liquid ke behne mein is rukaawat ko viscosity kehte hain.

Units: SI unit kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹; CGS unit poise (P).

Awaamil:
1. Temperature: temperature barhne se molecules ki ausat KE barhti hai, woh kashish par qaabu paate hain; viscosity kam hoti hai.
2. Intermolecular forces: forces jitni mazboot, viscosity utni zyada, kyunke molecules aazaadi se aik doosre ke gird harkat nahi kar sakte.

book_ref.quote: This means that a slow moving layer of a liquid tends to slow down the fast moving layer adjacent to it.

blocks.prompt:
16 Define evaporation. Explain why evaporation causes cooling, with two examples from daily life. (4 marks)
(Evaporation ki definition likhein. Wazahat karein ke evaporation thandak kyun paida karti hai, rozmarra ki do misalon ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Evaporation liquid ka har temperature par khud-ba-khud vapour mein badalna hai.

Thandak: Liquid se nikalne wale molecules zyada energy wale hote hain; kam energy wale peeche reh jaate hain, is liye liquid ka temperature girta hai. Phir garmi aas paas se liquid mein jati hai aur aas paas ka temperature bhi girta hai. Is liye evaporation thandak paida karti hai.

Misalein:
1. Nahaane ke baad hawa mein insaan ko thandak mehsoos hoti hai: jism se paani bukhaarat banta hai aur us ke molecules jism ki energy le jaate hain.
2. Matti ke bartan masaamdaar (porous) hain. Kaafi KE wale paani ke molecules masaamon se nikal kar bukhaarat bante hain; energy paani se li jati hai, baaqi molecules ki ausat KE kam hoti hai aur paani thanda rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: This phenomenon helps to understand that evaporation causes cooling.

blocks.prompt:
17 Define vapour pressure. Explain how equilibrium is reached when a liquid evaporates in a closed vessel, and state on what vapour pressure does not depend. (4 marks)
(Vapour pressure ki definition likhein. Wazahat karein ke band bartan mein liquid ke evaporate hone par equilibrium kaise qaayam hota hai, aur vapour pressure kin cheezon par munhasir nahi.)
blocks.explanation:
Khule bartan mein satah chhorne wale molecules hawa mein mil kar nikalte rehte hain. Band bartan mein vapour molecules satah ke oopar jama hote hain; deewaron aur liquid ki satah se takraate hain aur kuch liquid mein wapas pakre jaate hain. Yeh condensation hai.

Evaporation aur condensation jaari rehte hain yahan tak ke evaporation ki raftaar condensation ki raftaar ke barabar ho jaye (Figure 5.8):
Liquid ⇌ Vapour (aage evaporation, peeche condensation)

Definition: Kisi temperature par apne liquid ke saath equilibrium mein vapour jo pressure daalta hai use vapour pressure kehte hain.

Vapour pressure in par munhasir nahi:
1. bartan mein liquid ki miqdaar;
2. bartan ka hajm;
3. liquid ka surface area: bara area evaporation barhaata hai magar wapas aane wale molecules ka nishaana bhi bara hai, is liye condensation bhi barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: But if we close the system the molecules of liquid start gathering above the surface.

blocks.prompt:
18 Define boiling point. Explain what happens at the molecular level when a liquid is heated to its boiling point and why its temperature then stays constant. (4 marks)
(Boiling point ki definition likhein. Wazahat karein ke liquid ko boiling point tak garam karne par molecular satah par kya hota hai aur phir temperature kyun qaayam rehta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Boiling point woh temperature hai jis par liquid ka vapour pressure atmospheric ya bairooni pressure ke barabar ho jata hai.

Garam karne par: Liquid garam karne par us ka vapour pressure barhta jata hai aur molecules ki kinetic energy barhti hai, jis se temperature barhta hai. Jab vapour pressure bairooni pressure ke barabar ho jaye to liquid ubalta hai: andar ban'ne wale vapour ke bulbulon ka andaroni pressure satah par atmospheric pressure se zyada hota hai, is liye woh nikal kar satah par phat'te hain. Bulbulon ki musalsal dhaara nikalti hai.

Qaayam temperature: Boiling point par mazeed garmi temperature nahi barhaati. Yeh garmi intermolecular forces todne aur liquid ko vapour banane mein lagti hai.

Figure 5.9 dikhata hai ke paani, ethyl alcohol, ethylene glycol aur diethyl ether samandar ki satah par 760 torr vapour pressure par apne boiling point par pohanchte hain.

book_ref.quote: This makes the bubbles to come out of the liquid and burst at the surface.

blocks.prompt:
19 Discuss the two factors that affect the boiling point of a liquid, with examples. How does a pressure cooker make use of one of them? (4 marks)
(Liquid ke boiling point par asar daalne wale do awaamil misalon ke saath bayan karein. Pressure cooker in mein se aik ko kaise istemal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Intermolecular forces ki taaqat: Forces jitni mazboot, vapour pressure utna kam aur boiling point utna zyada. Paani (100.00 °C) ki forces ethanol (78.30 °C) se mazboot hain; Table 5.4 ki doosri qeematein: acetic acid 118.50 °C, acetone 56.00 °C, CS₂ 46.30 °C.

2. Bairooni pressure: Liquid tab ubalta hai jab vapour pressure bairooni pressure ke barabar ho. Zyada bairooni pressure par barabar karne ke liye zyada garmi chahiye, is liye boiling point barhta hai; kam bairooni pressure par kam garmi chahiye aur liquid kam temperature par ubalta hai.
Misalein: paani 1489 torr par 120 °C, 23.7 torr par 25 °C, aur Murree (700 torr) mein 98 °C par ubalta hai.

Pressure cooker: Yeh band bartan hai; bhaap bahar nahi nikalti aur paani ki satah par zyada pressure banati hai. Boiling temperature barhta hai, paani zyada garmi jazb karta hai aur khana jaldi pakta hai.

book_ref.quote: It means that when external pressure is changed, its boiling point will also change.

blocks.prompt:
20 Define molar heat of fusion and molar heat of vaporization, with equations for water. Explain how these heats affect the particles of matter, and why ΔHv of water is greater than that of NH₃ and HCl. (4 marks)
(Molar heat of fusion aur molar heat of vaporization ki definitions paani ki equations ke saath likhein. Wazahat karein ke yeh garmi maadde ke particles par kaise asar daalti hai, aur paani ki ΔHv NH₃ aur HCl se zyada kyun hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Har physical change ke saath energy change hoti hai jo intermolecular forces ki taaqat ke farq ki pemaish hai.

Molar heat of fusion (ΔHf): 1 atm par aik mole solid ko us ke melting point par liquid banane ke liye jazb hone wali garmi.
H₂O(s) → H₂O(l)   ΔHf = 6.01 kJ mol⁻¹ (0 °C par)

Molar heat of vaporization (ΔHv): 1 atm par aik mole liquid ko us ke boiling point par aik mole vapour banane ke liye jazb hone wali garmi.
H₂O(l) → H₂O(g)   ΔHv = 40.6 kJ mol⁻¹ (100 °C par)

Particles par asar: Yeh garmi particles ko itni energy deti hai ke woh aik doosre se door ho jaate hain aur solid liquid, liquid gas ban jata hai. Liquid aur gas mein particles ko harkat aur ghoomne ki zyada aazaadi milti hai.

Muqabla: ΔHv intermolecular forces ki taaqat par munhasir hai. NH₃ aur HCl ko sirf 21.7 aur 15.6 kJ mol⁻¹ chahiye jab ke paani ko 40.6 kJ mol⁻¹, kyunke paani mein mazboot intermolecular forces (wasee hydrogen bonding) hain.

book_ref.quote: The molar heats of vaportization depends upon the strength of intermolecular forces.

blocks.prompt:
21 Calculate (i) the heat needed to melt 72 g of ice at 0 °C and (ii) the heat needed to vaporize 72 g of water at 100 °C. (iii) How many times larger is the second? (ΔHf = 6.01 kJ mol⁻¹, ΔHv = 40.6 kJ mol⁻¹, molar mass of H₂O = 18 g mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(Garmi nikalein: (i) 0 °C par 72 g barf pighlaane aur (ii) 100 °C par 72 g paani ko vapour banane ke liye. (iii) Doosri garmi pehli se kitne guna zyada hai? (ΔHf = 6.01 kJ mol⁻¹, ΔHv = 40.6 kJ mol⁻¹, H₂O ka molar mass = 18 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Mass ko moles mein badlein, phir garmi = moles × molar heat.

book_ref.quote: H₂O(s) → H₂O(l), ΔHf = 6.01 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.final_answer: (i) 24.0 kJ (ii) 162.4 kJ (iii) vaporization ko taqreeban 6.8 guna zyada garmi chahiye

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Vaporization mein molecules ko aik doosre se bilkul alag karna parta hai, jab ke pighalne mein sirf un ki jagah dheeli hoti hai. Is liye ΔHv (40.6) ΔHf (6.01) se kahin zyada hai.

blocks.prompt:
22 Define solids. Describe the following properties of solids on the basis of kinetic molecular theory: (i) compression (ii) expansion (iii) motion of particles (iv) inter-particle forces and kinetic energy. (4 marks)
(Solids ki definition likhein. Kinetic molecular theory ki bunyaad par solids ki yeh khusoosiyaat bayan karein: (i) compression (ii) phailao (iii) particles ki harkat (iv) particles ki forces aur kinetic energy.)
blocks.explanation:
Solids woh maadde hain jo sakht hain aur un ki muqarrara shakal aur muqarrara hajm hai. Un ke atoms, ions ya molecules qareeb pack aur mazboot cohesive forces se jure hain, is liye be-tarteeb harkat nahi kar sakte.

(i) Compression: Particles qareeb pack hain aur mazeed qareeb nahi aa sakte. Metallic solids mein gol atoms hexagonal aur cubic close-packed structures banate hain; un ki hudood chhooti hain magar 74% se zyada jagah nahi gher sakte. Is liye solids ka compression mumkin nahi.

(ii) Phailao: Kashish ki forces itni mazboot hain ke temperature barhne se particles ki jagah mushkil se badalti hai; hajm mushkil se barhta hai. Expansion ke coefficients liquids aur gases ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar hain.

(iii) Harkat: Particles mein translatory ya rotational harkat nahi; woh sirf apni darmiyani jagah par thartharaate hain, zyada temperature par zyada tezi se.

(iv) Forces aur KE: Particles ionic, covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces se jure hain jo unhein jagah par qaaim rakhti hain. Is liye solids ki sirf vibrational kinetic energy hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: They are held together by strong cohesive forces.

blocks.prompt:
23 Define crystal lattice. Explain how crystals are grown from a solution, using sodium thiosulphate as an example, and explain the habit of a crystal. (4 marks)
(Crystal lattice ki definition likhein. Sodium thiosulphate ki misaal se wazahat karein ke solution se crystals kaise ugaaye jaate hain, aur crystal ki habit bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Crystal lattice: teen-jihati jagah mein ions, atoms ya molecules ki baqaida tarteeb. Muqarrara baqaida teen-jihati shakal wale solids (diamond, NaCl, barf) crystalline hain.

Crystals ki growth: Kisi crystalline maadde ka munaasib solvent mein saturated ya supersaturated solution, particles ki tarteeb se usi qisam ke crystals deta hai. Yeh solvent ki aahista evaporation ya saturated solution mein seeding (beej daalna) se hota hai.

Misaal: 100 °C par Na₂S₂O₃ ki paani mein solubility 231 g/100 cm³ hai. 100 °C par saturated solution ko aahista thanda karein to crystal growth nahi hoti: supersaturated solution solid ke saath equilibrium mein nahi hota. Jab Na₂S₂O₃ ka chhota crystal daala jaye (seeding) to tezi se crystallization hoti hai.

Crystal ki habit: jis shakal mein crystal aam taur par ugta hai. Halaat qaayam rahein to shakal hamesha wohi rehti hai; halaat badlein (maslan solution mein urea jaisi milawat) to shakal badal sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: This happens through the process called growth of crystals.

blocks.prompt:
24 What are amorphous solids? Give examples and describe their properties. (4 marks)
(Amorphous solids kya hain? Misalein dein aur un ki khusoosiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Amorphous solids, crystalline solids ke bar-aks, baqaida teen-jihati geometrical shakal nahi rakhte.
Misalein: glass, lakri, amorphous sulphur (plastic sulphur), charcoal, koyla, coke.

Khusoosiyaat:
1. Crystallites: in mein particles ki baqaida tarteeb ke chhote hisse (crystallites) ho sakte hain magar lambi hadd ki baqaidgi nahi.
2. Pighalna: glass jaise amorphous solids temperature ki wide range mein pighalte hain, kisi sharp point par nahi.
3. Shakal dena: inhein saanche mein dhaala aur phoonk kar mukhtalif shaklein di ja sakti hain.
4. Heat of fusion: in ki heat of fusion ki muqarrara qeemat nahi.
5. Isotropy: in ki khusoosiyaat pemaish ki simt par munhasir nahi.
6. Geometry: aam taur par dhelon (lumps) ya baareek powder ki shakal mein milte hain.

book_ref.quote: The amorphous solids can have small regions where orderly arrangement of particles is found

blocks.prompt:
25 What are liquid crystals? Describe the shape, arrangement and motion of their molecules, and the change in phase when a crystalline solid of such a substance is heated. (4 marks)
(Liquid crystals kya hain? Un ke molecules ki shakal, tarteeb aur harkat bayan karein, aur aise maadde ke crystalline solid ko garam karne par phase ki tabdeeli likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Liquids aur solids ka farq aam taur par saaf aur tabdeeli sharp hoti hai. Magar kuch temperatures par bohat se maadde aisi haalat mein hote hain jo na poori liquid na poori solid hai.

Definition: Woh maadde jin ke molecules gaarhe liquids ki tarah harkat karte hain magar solids ki tarah mehdood harkat rakhte hain liquid crystals kehlate hain.

Garam karne par phase ki tabdeeli:
Crystalline solid → Cloudy liquid (liquid crystal) → Clear liquid

Shakal aur tarteeb: Aksar liquid crystals mein molecules sakht aur rod jaise hain, lambai diameter se chaar se aath guna. Ikatthe hon to un ki lambi axes taqreeban mutawazi hoti hain, lakri ke dher mein lakriyon ki tarah.

Harkat: Akele molecules fluid mein chal sakte hain aur lambi axis ke gird ghoom sakte hain magar sira-ba-sira nahi palat sakte.

Is liye yeh liquids ki tarah behte aur viscosity dikhate hain, magar crystals ki tarah optical khusoosiyaat rakhte hain aur hamesha anisotropic hain.

book_ref.quote: When packed together, the molecules tend to orient with their long axes roughly parallel
